name: Peace
overview: Biblical peace encompasses reconciliation and harmony rooted in God's blessing and the right relationships among His people. The examples of Abraham's peaceful separation from Lot (Genesis 13:8-9) and Mordecai's commitment to speak peace to his brethren (Esther 10:3) illustrate a deliberate pursuit of peace that honors both God and neighbor. God's promise to grant peace in the land, where His people can rest without fear (Leviticus 26:6), underscores peace as a divine gift that fosters security and well-being. Scripture calls believers to actively promote peace, reflecting God's blessing and embodying the peace that flows from a life aligned with His will.
